rationale: All four lenses and the standards audit ran clean and parseable; every blind/edge-case candidate was verified against current source and none held up as a genuine defect (RUNNING-only status checks match explicit, test-verified spec requirements; isFetchDue and the queued-refetch race-handling concerns are false positives against the real control flow; the chats.ts dead branch is harmless because all real getChat call sites operate on the already-open chat). 10 findings dismissed as noise after verification; 1 pre-existing finding deferred (usePolling.tsx has no timeout around a hung fetchFn, predates this change). No acceptance criterion failed or was partial; one criterion is pending-stage-7 (test-suite execution evidence). Standards audit found no blocking violations and no coverage gap.
